== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：監房ブロック回廊</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋1できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここでは、武器運命数を＋1できる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control here, you may add 1 to the Force drain. Dark Side. Here you may add 1 to weapon destiny.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light may add 1 to Force drain if you control. Dark may add 1 to weapon destiny here. English Dark adds 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws. One asterisk. Zero Light Force icons and one Dark Force icon. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-deathstardetentionblockcorridor.gif|Original English face]], [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor]].</ref>
